name: agent-memory-bridge
description: Cross-session memory for pi-coding-agent (pi-mono). A thin client for the local claude-mem worker: records tool activity, injects relevant past context, and registers a memory_recall search tool. Share memory across pi, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Open
